build_language_modeling_task: build a LanguageModelingTask to train a language model using HuggingFace or ByteLevelBPE tokenizers
load_dataset_for_split: load a dataset split like train or valid for language modeling with configurable token block sizes
configure_sample_break_mode: configure the LanguageModelingConfig sample_break_mode to control how samples are split at sentence or document boundaries
build_inference_dataset: build a dataset for inference that prepends BOS/EOS tokens and appends PAD tokens to targets
create_eval_lm_dataloader: create an evaluation dataloader for language model scoring with configurable context window and sharding
